primary_language: 100% Memory-Safe Rust (Fat LTO + single codegen units)

crates_breakdown.name: ferro-pkg
crates_breakdown.description: Secure multi-arch package manager & PE/MSI unpacker
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: 100.0% safe Rust. All file operations, tar decompression, and cryptographic hashing use safe memory abstractions.

crates_breakdown.name: ferro-init
crates_breakdown.description: PID 1 process supervisor, SCM_RIGHTS FD store, WinRE recovery
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: Exclusively scoped to POSIX FFI syscalls (libc::fork, libc::execve, libc::mount, libc::waitpid, libc::reboot) and SCM_RIGHTS descriptor passing via sendmsg/recvmsg.

crates_breakdown.name: ferro-core
crates_breakdown.description: Multi-call coreutils, shell engine, SO_REUSEPORT socket server
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: Strictly scoped to SO_REUSEPORT socket binding, POSIX pipe descriptor passing, and vDSO clock fallback wrappers.

crates_breakdown.name: ferro-gui
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: Scoped to /dev/fb0 mmap mapping and munmap cleanup.

crates_breakdown.name: ferro-compositor
crates_breakdown.description: Smithay pure-Rust Wayland compositor with DRM/KMS scanout
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: Scoped to libgbm and DRM/KMS buffer handle management.

crates_breakdown.name: xdg-desktop-portal-ferro
crates_breakdown.description: Native Wayland desktop portal for D-Bus FileChooser/ScreenCast
crates_breakdown.ffi_justification: 100.0% safe Rust. Pure zbus asynchronous D-Bus IPC.
